vehicleTypeReason: The pack is clearly police-oriented, with law-enforcement flags and police-only plate probability plus emergency siren metadata and police equipment parts in the stream files.

security.summary: This pack contains only vehicle models/textures and vehicle metadata plus a declarative fxmanifest.lua. The manifest has no executable logic, and the importer will ignore stale glob paths by regenerating its own manifest.

repairs.issue: Uses broad glob paths that may reference files not present in the uploaded pack.
repairs.action: Regenerate the manifest from actually present vehicle assets and metadata; omit missing optional paths.

remediation.summary: Quarantine the uploaded Lua scripts so only data-only vehicle assets and regenerated metadata remain.

actions.reason: Runtime Lua script is not permitted in a data-only vehicle pack and must be removed to eliminate executable behavior.
Runtime/config Lua script is outside the allowed vehicle-asset scope and must be removed to eliminate executable behavior.
